independent_audit.scope: Separate Counter counts and explicit route aggregation; existing exact rational same-budget oracle with certificate; no independent neural refit.

interpretation_limit: Frozen router scores target the old fallback and punctuation-retaining metric. New fallback replacement is a paired evaluation, not refitting or new TEST model selection. Native/fusion profiles cover TRAIN125 and all TEST300 only; full TRAIN1253 uses original/confidence90 profiles.

metric_definitions.casefold_alnum: Unicode casefold followed by isalnum on OCR and GT; keep every detection and care denominator; normalized empty strings never match; no IoU.
metric_definitions.casefold_exact: Unicode casefold exact lexical multiset; punctuation retained; no IoU.

routing_cost_scope: Logical routing on cached outputs; no fresh online inference or measured latency
